abstract: In this paper, we study optimal prevention in the presence of a correlated nonfinancial background risk. Under positive correlation, cross‐prudence in the nonfinancial attribute reduces optimal prevention. We establish this result in the most direct extension of the standard prevention problem with binary marginal distributions and show that it extends to richer settings. Our analysis highlights a broader implication: in economically relevant cases with loss probabilities below one‐half and positive correlation, cross‐prudence emerges as an additional force that discourages prevention. As a result, optimal prevention can fall below the expected‐cost minimizing level, even when agents are risk‐averse.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了存在相关非金融背景风险时的最优预防行为。在正相关条件下，非金融属性的交叉审慎性会降低最优预防水平。我们通过标准预防问题最直接的二元边际分布扩展形式确立了这一结论，并证明该结论可推广至更丰富的设定。分析揭示了一个更广泛的意义：在损失概率低于二分之一且存在正相关的经济相关情形中，交叉审慎性成为抑制预防行为的额外因素。因此，即便代理人具有风险厌恶特征，最优预防水平仍可能低于预期成本最小化水平。
title: Cross‐Prudence and Optimal Prevention
title_zh: 跨谨慎与最优预防

abstract: Quantifying merger effects and conducting other counterfactual analyses is often difficult in platform markets because direct and indirect network effects link demand within and across market sides. We develop a general empirical framework for two-sided markets that incorporates these effects within an otherwise standard empirical IO approach. The framework does not impose a particular demand specification: researchers can estimate flexible demand systems on each side, for example, using BLP-type demand on one side or both. We allow direct and indirect network effects to vary across groups. Standard one-sided merger simulation emerges as a special case when network effects are absent. We provide sufficient conditions for uniqueness in the coordination game within and across market sides and for existence and uniqueness in the firms’ pricing game. These conditions are testable. When these conditions hold, the framework supports recovery of marginal costs from firms’ first-order conditions and can be used to conduct counterfactual analysis, including merger simulation.
abstract_zh: 在平台市场中，量化并购效应及开展其他反事实分析往往较为困难，因为直接和间接网络效应将市场内及跨市场的需求相互关联。我们为双边市场构建了一个通用实证框架，在保留标准实证产业组织方法的基础上，将这些效应纳入其中。该框架不强制设定特定的需求函数形式：研究者可在各市场侧估计灵活的需求系统，例如在一侧或双侧采用BLP型需求模型。我们允许直接和间接网络效应在不同群体间存在差异。当不存在网络效应时，标准单边市场并购模拟即成为该框架的特例。我们为市场内及跨市场协调博弈的唯一性，以及企业定价博弈的存在性与唯一性提供了充分条件，这些条件均可检验。当这些条件成立时，该框架支持从企业一阶条件中反推边际成本，并可用于开展包括并购模拟在内的反事实分析。
title: An Empirical Framework for Platform Markets
title_zh: DP21786 平台市场的实证框架

abstract: Taxes on capital gains are deferred until realization whereas dividends are taxed upon accrual. This often makes dividends tax disadvantaged relative to share repurchases, which leads to the payout puzzle: why do firms pay dividends? This paper demonstrates that tax deferment can also provide a solution to this puzzle: if shareholders with an accrued capital gain and a non-zero investment horizon demand a premium to sell equity—as compensation for accelerated realizations (and taxation)—then dividends can become tax efficient. This mechanism is appealing because it can explain dividend payments without appealing to asymmetric information, incomplete contracting, repurchase constraints, and/or irrationality.
abstract_zh: 资本利得税在实现时递延缴纳，而股息则在应计时征税。这通常使股息相对于股票回购处于税收劣势，从而引发"股利之谜"：企业为何仍要支付股息？本文证明，税收递延机制同样能为这一谜题提供解释：若持有已实现资本利得且投资期限非零的股东要求溢价出售股权——作为加速实现（及纳税）的补偿——则股息可能具有税收效率。该机制的优势在于，无需借助信息不对称、不完全契约、回购限制或非理性行为等假设，即可解释股息支付现象。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The Lock-In Effect and the Corporate Payout Puzzle,

abstract: Monetary policy shapes macroeconomic conditions and may influence renewable energy development, a key element of the transition to low-carbon growth. Using cross-country panel data covering the period from 2000 to 2021, this study investigates how the policy rate affects the development of renewable energy. Building on a standard transmission framework, the analysis considers firms’ investment behaviour and links Monetary policy to energy efficiency, credit conditions, and technological innovation. An empirical analysis is conducted using panel data methods, complemented by robustness checks to validate the results. The findings suggest that increases in the policy rate are associated with a decline in renewable energy development across countries. In terms of mechanisms, energy efficiency and credit conditions serve as key channels through which Monetary policy affects renewable energy, particularly in capital-intensive sectors. Although monetary tightening stimulates technological innovation, such technological innovation is largely concentrated in basic research and does not translate into applied technologies. The heterogeneity analysis further shows that the effects differ by income group and OECD membership status. The findings contribute cross-national empirical evidence and provide policy insights into how Monetary policy can be better designed to support the advancement of renewable energy.
abstract_zh: 货币政策塑造宏观经济环境，并可能影响可再生能源发展——这是向低碳增长转型的关键要素。本研究利用2000年至2021年的跨国面板数据，探讨政策利率如何影响可再生能源发展。基于标准传导框架，分析考虑了企业的投资行为，并将货币政策与能源效率、信贷条件和技术创新联系起来。采用面板数据方法进行实证分析，并通过稳健性检验验证结果。研究发现，政策利率上升与各国可再生能源发展水平下降相关。在机制方面，能源效率和信贷条件是货币政策影响可再生能源的关键渠道，尤其是在资本密集型行业。尽管货币紧缩刺激了技术创新，但这种创新主要集中在基础研究领域，并未转化为应用技术。异质性分析进一步表明，这种影响因收入群体和OECD成员国身份而异。本研究提供了跨国实证证据，并为如何优化货币政策设计以支持可再生能源发展提供了政策启示。
title: Monetary policy and renewable energy development: a cross-country perspective
title_zh: 货币政策与可再生能源发展：跨国视角

abstract: In many scenarios, such as the evaluation of place-based policies, potential outcomes are not only dependent upon the unit's own treatment but also its neighbors' treatment. Despite this,"difference-in-differences"(DID) type estimators typically ignore such interference among neighbors. I show in this paper that the canonical DID estimators generally fail to identify interesting causal effects in the presence of neighborhood interference. To incorporate interference structure into DID estimation, I propose doubly robust estimators for the direct average treatment effect on the treated as well as the average spillover effects under a modified parallel trends assumption. I later relax common restrictions in the literature, such as immediate neighborhood interference and correctly specified spillover functions. Moreover, robust inference is discussed based on the asymptotic distribution of the proposed estimators.
title: Difference-in-differences with interference
title_zh: 存在干扰的双重差分法

abstract: This paper examines how trust among ultimate owners and their affiliates shapes business group structure and correlates with firm productivity. We first confirm that greater business group verticality is associated with higher firm productivity. We then develop a theoretical model explaining how bilateral trust influences group verticality. To test these predictions, we construct a novel dataset by developing an algorithm that extends Amadeus ownership links into ownership chains, allowing us to measure verticality for a large European sample. We find that groups with higher average trust among members are more vertically structured. Firm-level estimates indicate that more trustworthy affiliates are positioned in a layer closer to the ultimate owner and exhibit higher productivity. Results are robust to using somatic distance as an instrument for bilateral trust.
title: Trust, business group verticality, and firm productivity
title_zh: 信任、企业集团垂直性与企业生产率

abstract: We assess whether layering an ultra-poor graduation program on Ethiopia’s Productive Safety Net Programme (PSNP) protects women and their households from localized weather shocks. Using panel data from a large cluster-randomized trial matched with detailed weather records, we identify community-level exposure to dryness shocks. Women who are exposed to dryness shocks experience deteriorating nutritional status (in conjunction with declining household food security and assets) and a significant increase in the risk of intimate partner violence. However, access to the graduation program fully buffers women from any increase in intimate partner violence, and partially buffers women and their households against other adverse effects. Further analysis suggests that improved household savings likely drives the program’s protective impact.
title: Do ultra-poor graduation programs build women’s resilience to weather shocks? Evidence from rural Ethiopia
title_zh: 极端贫困脱贫项目能否增强女性应对气候冲击的韧性？来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据

abstract: Favoritism as a mode of corruption is a major concern in public procurement (PP) in many countries. We propose a regression discontinuity design (RDD) test arguing that the winning history of marginal winners and losers can be used to detect favoritism. We apply the empirical test to PP of cleaning services in Finland and find evidence of favoritism even in this relatively low corruption environment. First, winners of close races in terms of win margin tend to have won more also in the past, which is in contrast to competitive environment. Second, to rule out an alternative explanation of collusion based on incumbency, we show that these winners also tend to submit their bids the last, indicating information sharing about rival bids from the buyer to the favored bidder.
abstract_zh: 偏袒作为一种腐败形式，是许多国家公共采购（PP）中的主要问题。我们提出了一种断点回归设计（RDD）检验，认为边际获胜者与失败者的获胜历史可用于检测偏袒行为。我们将该实证检验应用于芬兰清洁服务公共采购中，发现即使在腐败程度相对较低的环境中，偏袒现象依然存在。首先，以微弱优势获胜的竞标者（即获胜幅度接近的竞标者）往往在过去也赢得更多合同，这与竞争性环境形成对比。其次，为排除基于在位优势的合谋替代解释，我们证明这些获胜者还倾向于最后提交标书，这表明买方与受偏袒的竞标者之间存在关于竞争对手报价的信息共享。
title: Detecting Favoritism in Public Procurement
title_zh: 检测公共采购中的偏袒行为

abstract: Exploiting the establishment of public data platforms in China as a quasi-natural experiment, this paper systematically examines the impact of public data on the integration of manufacturing and service industries (MSI). We find that public data openness significantly promotes MSI. Mechanism analysis identifies two transmission channels through which public data openness promotes MSI. These channels are enterprise digital-intelligent transformation and high-skilled labour matching. We further find that the local market and institutional environment moderates this effect. The promotional impact is stronger in cities whose market and institutional environments are weaker. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that among various categories of public data, data pertaining to government services, market regulation, and fiscal and financial affairs exhibits a more pronounced promotional effect. The promotional effect is stronger in cities with more developed digital infrastructure and in non-resource-based cities. This study offers key policy implications for deepening public data openness and empowering regional industrial structure upgrading within the context of the digital economy.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国公共数据平台设立为准自然实验，系统考察了公共数据对制造业与服务业融合（MSI）的影响。研究发现，公共数据开放显著促进了制造业与服务业融合。机制分析揭示了公共数据开放促进产业融合的两条传导渠道：企业数智化转型与高技能劳动力匹配。进一步研究表明，本地市场与制度环境对该效应具有调节作用——在市场与制度环境较弱的城市，其促进效应更为显著。异质性分析显示，在各类公共数据中，政务服务、市场监管及财政金融类数据的促进效应尤为突出；数字基础设施更完善的城市及非资源型城市中，该促进效应更强。本研究为数字经济背景下深化公共数据开放、赋能区域产业结构升级提供了重要政策启示。

abstract: The consensus view among economists is that carbon prices, in order to be efficient, must be the same across the globe. But when there are inefficiencies in the allocation of capital so that countries are subject to different discount rates, we show that efficient carbon prices must be different across countries. This is a consequence of Hotelling’s familiar argument on the price of a non-renewable resource: it must grow at the rate of the next best use of marginal funds, which is equal to the country’s discount rate. If different countries discount at different rates, their carbon prices ought to grow at different rates as well. If they grow at different rates, they can’t be the same all of the time, as first-best carbon prices are. The computational climate policy literature has so far avoided this conclusion by altering time preferences in a country-specific way through time-varying Negishi weights. We show that the use of such weights causes inefficient policy prescriptions and, furthermore, has the particularly undesirable consequence of incorrectly discounting future consumption more in countries with high growth rates. The existence of inefficiencies in the savings process—causing differences in discount rates—is well-known and should be acknowledged head on in climate policy analysis. Doing so results in global mitigation policy with carbon price paths for different countries growing (efficiently) at different rates.
abstract_zh: 经济学家普遍认为，碳价格若要实现效率最优，必须在全球范围内保持一致。然而，当资本配置存在效率损失，导致各国面临不同的贴现率时，我们证明有效的碳价格必须因国而异。这一结论源于霍特林关于不可再生资源价格的经典论证：碳价格必须以边际资金次优用途的增长率上升，而该增长率等于该国的贴现率。若不同国家的贴现率存在差异，其碳价格也应以不同速率增长。由于增长速率不同，碳价格便无法像最优状态那样始终保持一致。现有气候政策计算文献通过引入随时间变化的尼格希权重来调整各国的时间偏好，从而回避了这一结论。我们证明，使用此类权重会导致政策建议缺乏效率，并产生尤为不良的后果——在高增长国家中，未来消费被错误地以更高贴现率折现。储蓄过程中的效率损失（导致贴现率差异）是公认现象，气候政策分析应直面这一问题。如此制定的全球减排政策，将使不同国家的碳价格路径以（有效的）不同速率增长。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: On Differentiated Carbon Prices and Discount Rates
title_zh: 差异化碳价格与贴现率研究

abstract: As a core component of human capital, education plays a pivotal role in shaping labour productivity. In remote and impoverished rural areas, limited access to post‐compulsory education creates a self‐perpetuating cycle of low education, low productivity, and entrenched poverty. Using data from China's Poverty Alleviation Through Relocation programme, this study examines the impact of relocation on children's post‐compulsory education, measured by high school enrolment. Employing a two‐way fixed effects model, we find that relocation increases the probability of high school enrolment by approximately 8.6 percentage points, with results robust to household controls and propensity score matching. Mechanism analysis provides suggestive evidence that these gains are associated with improved school accessibility, higher household income and increased educational investment. The effects are heterogeneous: educational gains are concentrated among male children and those in households with lower‐educated and older heads, are primarily driven by rural relocation, and increase with the duration since resettlement. The findings highlight both the potential and uneven distribution of human capital gains from relocation policies, providing important insights for targeted post‐relocation educational support in other developing country contexts.
abstract_zh: 作为人力资本的核心组成部分，教育在塑造劳动生产率方面发挥着关键作用。在偏远贫困的农村地区，义务教育后教育机会的匮乏形成了低教育水平、低生产率与根深蒂固贫困的自我循环。本研究利用中国易地扶贫搬迁项目数据，以高中入学率为衡量指标，考察搬迁对儿童义务教育后教育的影响。通过采用双向固定效应模型，我们发现搬迁使高中入学概率提升约8.6个百分点，该结果在加入家庭层面控制变量及倾向得分匹配后依然稳健。机制分析表明，这些教育收益与学校可达性改善、家庭收入提高及教育投资增加存在关联。异质性分析显示：教育收益集中于男性儿童、户主受教育程度较低及年龄较大的家庭；主要源于农村搬迁驱动；且随安置时间延长而递增。研究结果揭示了搬迁政策在人力资本积累方面的潜力与分配不均问题，为其他发展中国家制定针对性的搬迁后教育支持政策提供了重要启示。

title: Relocation and Educational Attainment: Evidence From China's Poverty Alleviation Programme

abstract: In Naylor, Deaton, and Ker (2025), we discuss an appropriate econometric method for estimating the pass‐through of the Nutrition North subsidy in the presence of heterogeneous effects and endogenous sampling. Applying this method to the data set compiled by Galloway and Li (2023), who conclude that there is “large leakage” of the subsidy, we fail to find evidence that supports their conclusion. After our paper was published, Galloway and Li published both a corrigendum to their 2023 article and a comment to our paper based on that corrigendum. In their comment, Galloway and Li (2026) claim that after “minor but easily justified” changes to their original data, our econometric approach leads to either imprecise or incomplete estimates of pass‐through. In our response we show that: (i) Galloway and Li (2026) choose a classification of market structure that differs from the one recommended by federal government officials and from the classification they themselves use in their most recent work, including Galloway and Li (2025b) and Li, Daley, and Watson (2025); (ii) the classification structure consistent with the recommendations of federal government officials and their aforementioned research supports full pass‐through; (iii) Galloway and Li's (2026) removal of 75% of the original sample is not minor; and (iv) Galloway and Li's (2026) repeated emphasis on sub‐sampling, robustness, and statistical power is incomplete and thus misleading. Importantly, our response emphasizes that the correct econometric approach does not turn on whether one can selectively find a data set in which the empirical estimate of pass‐through changes.
abstract_zh: 在Naylor、Deaton与Ker（2025）的研究中，我们探讨了在存在异质性效应与内生抽样条件下，估算“营养北方”补贴传导效应的适当计量方法。将该方法应用于Galloway与Li（2023）编制的数据集（该研究得出补贴存在“大量渗漏”的结论）后，我们未能发现支持其结论的证据。论文发表后，Galloway与Li针对其2023年文章发布了勘误，并基于该勘误对我们的论文发表了评论。在评论中，Galloway与Li（2026）声称，对其原始数据进行“微小但易于论证”的调整后，我们的计量方法对传导效应的估算要么不精确，要么不完整。我们的回应表明：（i）Galloway与Li（2026）选择的市场结构分类，既不同于联邦政府官员推荐的分类标准，也不同于其自身最新研究（包括Galloway与Li（2025b）及Li、Daley与Watson（2025））所使用的分类；（ii）与联邦政府官员建议及上述研究一致的分类结构支持完全传导效应；（iii）Galloway与Li（2026）剔除75%原始样本的做法并非“微小调整”；（iv）Galloway与Li（2026）反复强调子样本分析、稳健性与统计功效的做法不完整且具有误导性。重要的是，我们的回应强调：正确的计量方法并不取决于能否选择性找到传导效应实证估计值发生变化的数据集。
title: Reply to Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
title_zh: 回复《关于加拿大北部营养补贴传导率的评论》

abstract: There is a need to assess the benefits of government policy to improve the welfare of food animals. We present a holistic, animal-centred welfare assessment method using an expert panel of independent animal welfare scientists linked to a survey of food shoppers’ willingness to pay (WTP) to improve welfare levels, using a 0–100 animal welfare scale. We apply this method to six food animal types in the UK and 15 different topical policy scenarios. We find that several current production systems have welfare scores below 50 but that some of the policy initiatives analysed could increase welfare scores substantially if implemented. We provide valuation tables of people’s WTP to increase welfare scores for each of the six animal types. Marginal WTP was found to diminish as welfare scores increased. WTP values are fully transferable across any policies affecting the animals involved and are not tied to specific production practices or contexts. The UK government has been using the method to evaluate a range of policy options to improve welfare. The method can be applied in other countries. The method enables government policy makers to better make the case for policies to improve the welfare of food animals and its application should lead to an increased likelihood of such policies being implemented. The outputs can also be used to inform consumers regarding the animal welfare provenance of the food they purchase. Previous article in issue Next article in issue

abstract: Despite major institutional reforms, the European Banking Union remains incomplete. Banking markets remain fragmented along national lines, which constrains Europe’s growth potential. This column uses loan-level data from the European credit registry combined with the bank group structure dataset to quantify where the barriers to cross-border lending lie, what role cross-country regulatory differences play, and how much output Europe forgoes as a result. It finds that the binding constraints sit on the extensive margin, that is, forming relationships and entering markets, that they are closely related to regulatory fragmentation, and that lifting them may deliver sizeable economic gains.
abstract_zh: 尽管经历了重大制度改革，欧洲银行业联盟仍不完善。银行业市场仍沿国界分割，这制约了欧洲的增长潜力。本专栏利用欧洲信贷登记机构的贷款级数据，结合银行集团结构数据集，量化了跨境贷款的障碍所在、跨国监管差异的作用，以及由此导致的欧洲产出损失。研究发现，约束性障碍主要存在于广延边际层面，即建立关系和进入市场方面，这些障碍与监管碎片化密切相关，而消除这些障碍可能带来可观的经济收益。

abstract: Populist leaders increasingly cast public sector experts, oversight bodies, and career civil servants as illegitimate ‘elites’ standing in the way of the popular will. But bureaucratic institutions may protect the economy from the very disruptions that populists invite. This column examines the role of bureaucracy in mediating the negative effects of populist governments at the US state level. The results suggest that bureaucracy matters. In countries and states with career civil‐service protections, the usual drag of populist governance largely vanishes, but without those institutional cushions, the economy takes a hit. What matters is whether the bureaucracy is professional and insulated from political control.
abstract_zh: 民粹主义领导人日益将公共部门专家、监督机构及职业公务员视为阻碍民意的非法“精英阶层”。然而，官僚机构或许能保护经济免受民粹主义所引发的动荡。本专栏考察了美国州级层面官僚机构在调节民粹主义政府负面影响中的作用。研究结果表明，官僚机构至关重要。在拥有职业公务员保护制度的国家与州，民粹主义治理通常带来的经济拖累基本消失；但若缺乏这些制度缓冲，经济将遭受冲击。关键在于官僚体系是否具备专业性且不受政治控制。
authors: Massimo Morelli, Dmitrii Petrukhin, Matia Vannoni
title: Don’t drain the swamp! Populism, bureaucracy, and economic performance
title_zh: 不要抽干沼泽！民粹主义、官僚主义与经济绩效

abstract: In this paper, we study the effects of the Women’s Labor Subsidy (WLS), introduced in 2012, on women’s labor outcomes. We use detailed administrative records for more than 2.5 million women that allow us to analyze employment and income trajectories before, during, and after the implementation of the subsidy. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits the fact that eligibility is contingent upon falling below a specified vulnerability score cutoff, we analyze how eligibility and being a program beneficiary affect labor outcomes. Our results indicate no significant effects of WLS eligibility on women’s employment, months worked, or income. We also find null effects on labor outcomes for program beneficiaries. The null effect is relatively consistent across different subgroups of eligible women.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2012年实施的女性劳动补贴（WLS）对女性劳动结果的影响。我们利用超过250万女性的详细行政记录，分析了补贴实施前、实施期间及实施后的就业与收入轨迹。通过采用断点回归设计，利用资格取决于是否低于特定脆弱性评分阈值的特征，我们分析了资格认定及成为项目受益人对劳动结果的影响。研究结果表明，WLS资格对女性就业、工作月数或收入均无显著影响。同时，项目受益人的劳动结果也未发现显著效应。这一零效应在不同合格女性子群体中相对一致。
title: Women’s labor subsidy: Evidence from Chile
title_zh: 女性劳动补贴：来自智利的证据

abstract: Contemporary land use policy rests on a foundational and insufficiently examined premise that the exogenous operating environment of cities will remain within historically derived parameters adequate for extrapolative planning. This paper terms that premise the stability premise and argues that its structural dissolution constitutes not a series of correctable policy failures but a fundamental reconfiguration in the conditions under which urban governance operates. The concept of Volatile Urbanismis introduced to theorise that transformation: defined as the structural condition produced when disruptions to urban operating systems arrive with a velocity, simultaneity, and cross-systemic compounding that systematically exceeds the adaptive capacity of the institutions governing those cities. Three constitutive properties are identified and theorised: (i) transmission without proximity, (ii) compounding rather than sequential disruption, and (iii) institutional lag as the primary vulnerability mechanism, with implications for urban finance, infrastructure insurance, public health systems, and municipal fiscal governance. The framework is distinguished from the cognate concepts of fragility, vulnerability, and resilience, including its most sophisticated reformulations through transformative and evolutionary resilience theory, against which it offers a theoretically bounded contribution focused on the velocity-institution mismatch as a distinct governance failure mode. Specific implications are developed for zoning and land classification, infrastructure investment appraisal, development planning, and urban finance. The paper argues that land use policy is both the domain in which the stability premise is most durably encoded and the most consequential site for its reformulation. The framework arrives at a moment when the 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure, the 2023–2024 Red Sea shipping crisis, and the compound urban consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic have made the theoretical inadequacy of existing frameworks empirically evident. abstract_zh: 当代土地利用政策建立在一个基础性但未经充分检验的前提之上，即城市的外生运行环境将维持在历史参数范围内，足以支撑外推式规划。本文将这一前提称为“稳定性前提”，并认为其结构性瓦解并非一系列可纠正的政策失误，而是城市治理运行条件发生的根本性重构。本文引入“波动城市主义”概念来理论化这一转变：将其定义为当城市运行系统受到的冲击以某种速度、同时性及跨系统复合效应系统性超出治理这些城市的制度适应能力时所产生的结构性状态。本文识别并理论化了三个构成性属性：（i）无需邻近即可传播，（ii）复合而非序列性冲击，以及（iii）制度滞后作为主要脆弱性机制，并探讨其对城市财政、基础设施保险、公共卫生系统及市政财政治理的影响。该框架与脆弱性、易损性和韧性等相近概念相区分，包括通过变革性韧性理论和演化韧性理论进行的最为复杂的重新表述，并在此基础上提供了一个理论边界明确的贡献，聚焦于速度-制度错配作为一种独特的治理失效模式。本文进一步探讨了该框架对区划与土地分类、基础设施投资评估、发展规划及城市财政的具体影响。本文认为，土地利用政策既是稳定性前提被最持久编码的领域，也是对其进行重构的最关键场域。该框架提出的时机恰逢2026年霍尔木兹海峡关闭、2023-2024年红海航运危机以及COVID-19大流行带来的复合城市后果，使得现有框架的理论不足在经验上变得显而易见。
title: Volatile urbanism: Rethinking planning beyond the stability premise
title_zh: 波动城市主义：超越稳定性前提的规划再思考

abstract: Public employment guarantee schemes, which channeled graduates into lifetime positions in the civil service and state-owned enterprises, were central to state-led industrialization across the postcolonial world, yet they have remained far less studied than temporary workfare programs. This paper provides the first causal estimates of their labor market effects, exploiting the Arab Republic of Egypt's archetypal public employment guarantee, which from the early 1960s guaranteed public sector jobs to secondary and university graduates without competitive examination. The paper measures district-level exposure by secondary school supply on the eve of the reform (1959/60) and links it to individual-level census microdata from 1986, 1996, and 2006. Using an event-study design with continuous treatment intensity, the analysis compares cohorts that differed in age at the time of the public employment guarantee's introduction across districts with differing pre-reform school supply. The findings show that the public employment guarantee reallocated urban male wage employment away from the private sector and toward state-owned enterprises, with no comparable shift in rural districts, where state-owned enterprises were largely absent. The reallocation was concentrated in manufacturing and high-skilled white-collar occupations, consistent with the policy channeling educated workers into sectors that were central to the state's industrialization drive. The paper finds little evidence that the public employment guarantee raised educational attainment, indicating that it primarily redirected an already growing pool of educated workers rather than expanding the supply of schooling.
abstract_zh: 公共就业保障计划是后殖民世界国家主导工业化的核心举措，它将毕业生引入公务员和国有企业的终身职位，但相较于临时工作福利计划，其研究程度远为不足。本文首次对其劳动力市场效应进行因果估计，利用阿拉伯埃及共和国的典型公共就业保障制度——自20世纪60年代初起，该制度保证中学和大学毕业生无需竞争性考试即可获得公共部门职位。本文以改革前夕（1959/60年）的中学供给衡量地区级暴露程度，并将其与1986年、1996年和2006年的人口普查个体微观数据相关联。采用连续处理强度的事件研究设计，分析比较了在公共就业保障制度引入时年龄不同的队列，这些队列分布在改革前学校供给存在差异的地区。研究结果表明，公共就业保障将城市男性工资就业从私营部门重新配置到国有企业，而在国有企业基本缺失的农村地区则未出现类似转变。这种重新配置集中于制造业和高技能白领职业，与政策将受教育工人引导至国家工业化核心部门的逻辑一致。本文未发现公共就业保障显著提高教育程度的证据，表明其主要重新引导了本已增长的受教育工人群体，而非扩大教育供给。

abstract: We study the evolution of bank branch networks in ten CESEE countries between 2013 and 2021. Using a manually compiled dataset of all branches and their geocoordinates, we document a decline exceeding 30%, with substantial heterogeneity across and within countries. We show that banking market consolidation is a key driver of closures, while profitability and local economic growth mitigate them. Branches in highly urban or very rural areas close more often. Competitive effects are nonlinear: moderate clustering lowers closure risk, but intense competition increases it. These patterns differ markedly across CESEE banking systems during the entire period we analyze. JEL Classification: D53, G21, R12
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2013年至2021年间十个中东欧及东南欧国家（CESEE）银行分支网络的变化。基于手动编制的全部分支机构及其地理坐标数据集，我们记录了超过30%的降幅，且各国及国内各地区存在显著异质性。研究表明，银行市场整合是分支机构关闭的关键驱动因素，而盈利能力和地方经济增长则能缓解这一趋势。高度城市化或偏远地区的分支机构关闭频率更高。竞争效应呈现非线性特征：适度集聚降低关闭风险，但激烈竞争则增加该风险。在我们分析的整个时期内，这些模式在CESEE各银行体系中存在显著差异。JEL分类号：D53, G21, R12

abstract: This paper uses rich, administrative-quality data on earnings in the UK from the Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE) to provide a detailed analysis of income risk and its patterns across individuals and over time. We develop a model of income dynamics that accounts for the broader state of the economy and successfully captures key features of the UK earnings growth distribution, including: a cyclical variance, procyclical skewness (more frequent negative earnings shocks during recessions), and a distribution that combines sharp peaks with long, heavy tails. The model is simple enough to be integrated into broader macroeconomic frameworks, such as heterogeneous agent models, and could be used to support policy scenario analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文利用英国《工时与收入年度调查》（ASHE）中具有行政质量的高精度收入数据，对收入风险及其在个体间与时间维度上的分布模式进行了详细分析。我们构建了一个考虑宏观经济整体状态的收入动态模型，该模型成功捕捉了英国收入增长分布的关键特征，包括：周期性方差、顺周期偏度（经济衰退期间负向收入冲击更为频繁），以及兼具尖峰与长厚尾特征的分布形态。该模型结构简洁，可整合至更广泛的宏观经济框架（如异质性主体模型）中，并可用于支持政策情景分析。
title: Modelling income risk dynamics in the UK: a parametric approach
